Package `kinference` allows users to use SNP genotype data from
biological samples to infer kin relationships between pairs of
samples. In this vignette, we demonstrate how to use the core
functions of package `kinference` to perform kin-finding and the
necessary data-cleaning steps that lead up to kin-finding (section 1),
and show a handful of canned examples of the sorts of things that can
go wrong (section 2).
